about: SFX Forge 카탈로그 — `npm run sfx:forge -- batch --catalog tools/sfx_forge_catalog.json --only <key,...>`. category별 공통 꼬리(장르·감쇠·금지)는 tools/sfx_forge.mjs CATEGORY_PRESETS가 붙인다. text에는 소리 자체만 적는다.

sounds.text: A crescent of cold silver sword energy released from a heavy blade swing: a sharp airy slice with a thin metallic ring and a brief spectral hiss
A giant infernal hammer slamming the ground: a deep earth-shaking boom, cracking stone and a short burst of hellfire embers
A frost orb conjured and launched: crystalline ice forming with a glassy crackle and a cold breathy whoosh
Iron spikes erupting from scorched earth: a fast grinding metal thrust with a dry crunch of soil
A heavy sword cutting into a demon's flesh: a wet meaty slash with a short gritty tear
A sword striking a skeleton: a hard bony crack with a dry splintering rattle
A perfectly timed parry: a bright tight steel-on-steel clang with a short sparking ring
A critical heavy strike on an armored demon: a punchy deep impact with a crunching armor dent and a low thump
A heavy iron grimoire opening: a low creak with a soft leather thud and faint ember crackle
A heavy iron grimoire closing: a muted leather thud with a short metal latch click
A tiny dry bone tick, very soft and subtle
A confident iron latch locking with a small warm ember flare
An infernal rune igniting: a rising ember whoosh ending in a soft resonant metallic glow
A burnt dead forest in hell: distant low wind, faint crackling embers and creaking dead branches
